exam.title: Cell Biology — Unit Test
exam.subject: Biology
exam.instructions: Each question carries 1 mark. Choose the single best option. No negative marking.
exam.difficultyNote: Calibrated from 3 sample questions of the 2025 paper: recall-based with a few application items.

questions.question: Which of the following is the main site of ATP synthesis in a eukaryotic cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are the powerhouse of the cell; oxidative phosphorylation and most ATP generation occur on their inner membrane.

questions.question: Ribosomes are composed of which of the following?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are nucleoprotein complexes made of ribosomal RNA (rRNA) and proteins, assembled in the nucleolus.

questions.question: Which organelle is responsible for the intracellular digestion of worn-out organelles and foreign material?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes contain hydrolytic enzymes (acid hydrolases) that digest macromolecules, worn-out organelles, and engulfed pathogens.

questions.question: The semifluid matrix filling the space between the nuclear envelope and the cell membrane is called the:
questions.explanation: Cytoplasm is the semifluid matrix between the nuclear envelope and plasma membrane; cytosol is its soluble part excluding organelles.

questions.question: Which of the following cell organelles is bounded by a single membrane?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes are single-membrane-bound organelles; mitochondria, plastids, and the nucleus have double membranes.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the cell wall is correct?
options: It is present in animal cells and made of cholesterol
It is found in plant cells and provides structural support
It regulates the movement of all molecules in and out of the cell
It is a selectively permeable membrane made of phospholipids
questions.explanation: Plant cell walls are made chiefly of cellulose, provide rigidity and support, and are freely permeable — unlike the plasma membrane.

questions.question: A student observes a cell with a prominent nucleus, a large central vacuole, and a cell wall. The cell is most likely a:
questions.explanation: A cell wall and large central vacuole are characteristic of mature plant cells; RBCs, neurons, and bacteria lack both together.

questions.question: The structural organisation of the nucleus includes the nuclear envelope, nucleoplasm, nucleolus, and:
questions.explanation: The nucleus comprises the nuclear envelope, nucleoplasm, nucleolus, and chromatin (DNA + histone proteins).
